name: Tickmark Todo
author: imanubdesigner
description: A tiny todo list in the Omarchy bar. Add items with a name and a description, tick them off into a bin you can restore from, and edit anything with a right-click.

barWidget.description: A tiny todo list in the bar. The icon shows how many are open. Tick items off into a restorable bin; right-click an item to edit it.
